title: Trichoscopy (hair loss exam)
what: The doctor examines your scalp and hair with a special magnifying camera. It is painless and helps find the cause of hair loss.
why: When hair falls out a lot, gets thinner, or bald patches appear.
duration: the exam usually takes 15 to 30 minutes; the report is usually ready right away
tell_doctor: When the hair loss started and what came before it: illness, stress, childbirth, or diets
Hormone problems, if you know of any

prepare.title: Washing
prepare.text: Usually do not wash your hair for 1 to 2 days before the exam. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Products
prepare.text: Do not use hairspray, gel, or dry shampoo on the day.

prepare.title: Coloring
prepare.text: Do not dye your hair for 1 to 2 weeks before the exam.

bring: Test results, if you already had tests
A list of medicines and supplements
steps: The doctor asks about your hair loss
The doctor examines your hair and scalp
The camera is placed on different parts of your head
The magnified image shows on a screen
Sometimes photos are taken to compare at the next visit
The doctor explains the results and orders tests or treatment
feel: It does not hurt. The camera just touches the skin
Sometimes the doctor gently tugs a strand to check how firmly the hair holds
after: You can wash your hair and use products right away
Have the tests done, if your doctor ordered them
A follow-up exam is usually after a few months of treatment

faq.q: Is it normal to lose hair every day?
faq.a: Yes, some hair falls out every day. If you notice much more than usual, see a doctor.
Hair grows slowly. Results are usually checked after 3 to 6 months.

reminders.text: Trichoscopy tomorrow. Usually do not wash your hair, and do not use hairspray or gel. Check with the clinic.
